timing_scopes.primary: retrieve() only: includes fixture-index search, deterministic reranker, per-query admission-index construction, validation and response materialization
timing_scopes.secondary: fixture/index/engine preparation plus retrieve(); not used for break-even
timing_scopes.execution_order: sequential, all six arm permutations twice per case
timing_scopes.sample_semantics: 12 repeated executions of each fixed fixture; not independent requests or stable tail estimates

limitations: Synthetic fixture index and deterministic reranker; not full product-path qualification
First observed crossover is machine/metadata dependent, not a stable production threshold
Shared-host load and allocation instrumentation can perturb timing
No peak RSS claim; allocation series count ordinary C++ new/new[] requests, not all allocator APIs
No production adoption or API/default/persisted-format change
